paragraphs: Rav Yosi. One of the Rabbanan Savora'i; see the entry Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: Rabbanan Savora’i means the Savoraic sages. Hyman classifies Rav Yosi among them and points to Rav Yosef; this faithfully retains his assertion without independently establishing the historical identification. Both Rav titles are written in full.
